title: King Chess
tagline: C# chess client — a complete game loop rather than a tutorial sprite demo.
overview: King Chess is a C# chess project on Codeberg. It is listed as a product because it is a full game, not a Dart utility package.
problem: Wanted a rules-heavy desktop/game client outside the Flutter/Laravel lane.
solution: A C# chess codebase published on Codeberg.
architecture: C# game project. Rules and UI live in the kingChess repository.
challenges: Encoding legal moves without a huge engine dependency
lessonsLearned: Rule systems are a different discipline from CRUD apps
futureImprovements: PGN export if the project is revisited
results: Playable chess client source on Codeberg
